(B) NOT DONE, blocked by the oracle surface, reported as instructed rather than forced. The remediation asks for one per-position disposition with to_read, carried, already_read, skipped and kept() DERIVED over it. No method can supply a movable field, and no wrapper type can, because the core target's return type is exactly Vec<usize>. So the shape cannot change while both test files stay untouched; the probe was reverted and resume.rs is byte-identical to HEAD. Owner: the acceptance designer, who would have to read the verdict through kept() (and one accessor for the skip reasons) in those two files; then the type change is free.
